name: Bonterms Cloud Terms
blurb: Balanced, plain-English cloud/SaaS terms that ship as a fixed document; the two sides negotiate only a short cover page instead of redlining the terms themselves.

name: Bonterms Professional Services Agreement
blurb: A standardized services agreement for implementation, consulting, and integration work, built on the same cover-page model as the rest of the Bonterms suite.

name: Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement
blurb: A structured B2B SaaS agreement with variables on a cover page and standing terms maintained by a committee of practicing attorneys, aimed at same-day signature.

name: Bonterms Mutual NDA
blurb: No-redline mutual confidentiality agreement: fill in the cover page (parties, term, exceptions) and leave the underlying obligations untouched.

name: Common Paper Mutual NDA
blurb: The template that launched Common Paper's library and remains its most widely adopted: a mutual NDA reported to have been downloaded tens of thousands of times by companies of all sizes.

name: oneNDA
blurb: A single, deliberately non-negotiable mutual NDA crowdsourced from clauses contributed by dozens of law firms and in-house teams; thousands of organizations now start (and stop) here.

name: Universal NDA (uNDA)
publisher: Bitmovin & UC Hastings Startup Legal Garage
blurb: Distilled from hundreds of real NDAs and interviews with Bay Area general counsel down to 13 clauses, then open-sourced on GitHub for anyone to fork.

name: ILPA Model Non-Disclosure Agreement
blurb: A model NDA for private-fund diligence, built so limited partners and general partners stop re-negotiating confidentiality terms before every secondary sale or diligence exercise.

name: Bonterms Data Protection Addendum
blurb: A standardized data protection addendum meant to bolt onto the Bonterms Cloud Terms or any other commercial agreement, covering processor obligations under GDPR- and CCPA-style regimes.

name: Common Paper CSA Data Addendum
blurb: Companion data-processing addendum for the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement, drafted to slot in without reopening the commercial terms.

name: EU Standard Contractual Clauses
blurb: The European Commission's modular clauses for lawfully exporting personal data outside the EU/EEA; modernized in 2021 to cover controller-to-processor and processor-to-processor transfers.

name: UK International Data Transfer Agreement
blurb: The UK's own successor to the EU SCCs for transfers out of the UK, alongside a shorter Addendum that bolts UK terms onto an existing EU SCC agreement.

name: IAB Multi-State Privacy Agreement (MSPA)
blurb: Contractual framework binding publishers, advertisers, and ad-tech vendors to shared privacy terms across the growing patchwork of US state privacy laws; successor to the 2020 CCPA-era LSPA.

name: IAB Europe TCF Policies
blurb: The Transparency & Consent Framework's binding policies for consent-management platforms and ad-tech vendors handling GDPR consent signals across the industry.

name: IAB / 4A's Standard Terms & Conditions for Media Buys (One Year or Less)
publisher: IAB & American Association of Advertising Agencies
blurb: The default insertion-order terms for US digital media buys under a year, jointly issued so agencies and publishers stop rewriting boilerplate for every campaign.

name: Y Combinator SAFE
blurb: The Simple Agreement for Future Equity: no interest, no maturity date, equity converts at the next priced round. Now the dominant pre-seed instrument well beyond YC's own portfolio.

name: NVCA Model Legal Documents
blurb: The charter, stock purchase agreement, investors' rights agreement, and related forms used as the starting point in the large majority of US priced venture rounds.

name: Series Seed Documents
blurb: An earlier open-source seed-financing document set, released to the public domain and now maintained collaboratively on GitHub as a lighter-weight alternative to a full priced round.

name: ISDA Master Agreement
blurb: The umbrella agreement underlying most over-the-counter derivatives trades worldwide: one negotiated schedule governs every confirmation signed afterward.

name: LSTA Model Credit Agreement Provisions
blurb: Standardized clauses for the US syndicated loan market, used so lead arrangers and borrowers aren't relitigating the same boilerplate on every leveraged loan.

name: LMA Facility Agreement Documentation
blurb: The London-based counterpart to the LSTA forms, setting the standardized facility agreements used as the default across European syndicated and leveraged lending.

name: AIA Contract Documents (A201 family)
blurb: The best-known US construction contract family (owner, architect, and contractor agreements built around the A201 General Conditions), revised on a roughly ten-year cycle.

name: ConsensusDocs
blurb: A rival US construction contract catalog drafted jointly by owner, contractor, and design coalitions rather than by architects alone, pitched as more balanced across parties.

name: FIDIC Suite of Contracts (the “Rainbow Suite”)
blurb: The standardized reference for cross-border infrastructure and engineering projects, color-coded by risk allocation: Red Book, Yellow Book, Silver Book, and more.

name: JCT Contracts
blurb: The default UK building contract suite, produced by a tribunal representing contractors, employers, and consultants across the construction industry.

name: NEC4 Engineering & Construction Contract
blurb: A collaboratively-drafted alternative to JCT and FIDIC built around active project management rather than after-the-fact dispute clauses; widely mandated on UK public infrastructure.

name: Creative Commons Licenses
blurb: The standardized public licenses for creative and published work, from CC0's full dedication to the public domain up to the most restrictive CC BY-NC-ND, now on their fourth major revision.

name: OSI-Approved Open Source Licenses (MIT / Apache 2.0 / GPL)
blurb: The reference texts for the license grants that govern nearly all public software: permissive (MIT, Apache 2.0) and copyleft (GPL) forms maintained under one approval process.

name: ACORD Forms
blurb: The insurance industry's standardized certificate-of-insurance and application forms, in use since 1971 and now the common data format most agency systems build around.

name: ICC Model International Sale Contract
blurb: A model form for cross-border sale of goods designed to sit alongside ICC Incoterms, giving exporters and importers a starting point instead of drafting a bespoke international contract each time.
